tasks.title: App thread and result protocol contracts
acceptance: Created child threads are not considered active until the App adapter can read them back through the stable readThread(threadId) path.
Thread binding rejects duplicate bindings and unreadable thread ids before lease activation.
Result parsing is append-only and idempotent, with one bounded correction path for missing or malformed result blocks.
App notLoaded remains a non-mutating wait state and does not register a failed child result.
Manual recovery remains explicit when correction cannot be delivered or repeated invalid output persists.
copyOnlyCommands: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { assertGoalRunbookContract } from './src/symphony/goal-runbook-contracts.js'; const path='fixtures/contracts/goal-runbook.v43-goal-supervisor-stabilization.v1.json'; const runbook=JSON.parse(await readFile(path,'utf8')); assertGoalRunbookContract(runbook); console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok:true, path, goalId:runbook.goalId, tasks:runbook.tasks.length, releaseGates:runbook.releaseGates }));"

tasks.title: Workspace and evidence safety
acceptance: Assigned worktrees are checked for dependency readiness before dispatch, including missing node_modules detection when package-local install state matters.
Dependency setup failures register explicit workspace-dependency-setup-failed blockers instead of dispatching a known-bad child.
Verified dirty-baseline inheritance records source worktree, target worktree, copied files, deleted files, and base commit details.
Role results are rejected when evidence exists only in the root checkout or outside the assigned worktree.
Verification inventory records tracked modifications, staged changes, deletions, and untracked files.

tasks.title: Route engine and status reconciliation
acceptance: Route decisions are derived from append-only goal events plus validated results rather than only summarized ledger state.
Reviewer approval is not counted as main verification or full task completion in release or supervisor logic.
Failed main verification routes back through worker revision and reviewer approval before returning to main verification.
Release closeout remains blocked until explicit closeout authorization is recorded.
Every consumed valid result registers exactly one goal event and can emit a reconciliation warning when goal-status disagrees.

tasks.title: Daemon, heartbeat, notifications, and progress visibility
acceptance: Daemon health is separated from manual tick freshness and runner progress state.
A stale daemon with an active child does not create duplicate work and instead emits an operator-visible inspection or restart action.
Blocked and approval-required states stay visible without reading raw state JSON.
Progress summaries cite v41 controlled runner operation ids and sanitized artifact refs instead of raw provider output.
Restart-safe heartbeat behavior either does nothing, restarts an idle stopped runner through one documented path, or asks for operator action.
